title: Pokémon’s First Movie Is Still Peak Even After 27 Years
content: With the number of anime series and movies Pokémon has released over the years, fans often find themselves celebrating major milestones throughout the year. However, there’s something special about the first movie that just can’t be beat.

title: Sega Streams Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond Short Animated Film on YouTube
content: Sega beagn streaming on Thursday the full Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond 35th anniversary short film : Dr. Eggman's new evil scheme is to upgrade Metal Sonic into the ultimate fighting machine by stealing Sonic's life-data and harnessing the power of the Chaos Emeralds.

title: Goten & Trunks Need Their Redemption in Dragon Ball Super’s Anime Future
content: Early in their fighting careers it looked like Trunks and Goten were on track to surpass their fathers and take up the mantle of protecting earth in the Dragon Ball universe. Instead, they faded into the background, while Goku, Vegeta, Piccolo and sometimes Gohan continued to raise their respective power levels .

title: Disney to Premiere Lilas Dreams & Memories Documentary About YOASOBI's Lilas Ikuta on December 30
content: Disney revealed on Thursday that Lilas Dreams & Memories , an original two-part documentary about the YOASOBI duo's singer-songwriter Lilas Ikuta (also known as ikura ), will stream on Disney+ and air on Disney Channel on December 30.

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game Adds Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture's Laocorn on November 19
content: SNK announced on Thursday that its Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game will add the Season Pass 3 DLC character Laocorn Gaudeamus from the Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture anime film on November 19.

title: Kakao Piccoma Launches New 'Lulumiru' BL Webtoon Platform
content: The service is available on web browsers on smartphones, tablets, and PCs. Membership is free and readers can purchase works chapter by chapter. Lulumiru hosts both new series and older series that have had lasting popularity.
